test_cases.title: Pipeline emit covers all 4 core phases on successful request
test_cases.description: Send a non-stream request. Verify post_route, pre_transport, post_response emit are called.
steps: Build test app with in-memory DB
Mock backend returns 200 with valid chat completion
Verify emit was called for post_route, pre_transport, post_response phases

test_cases.title: Pipeline emit on_error on upstream failure
test_cases.description: Send a request that triggers an error. Verify emit('on_error') is called.

test_cases.title: builtin:route-resolve selects first non-excluded target
test_cases.description: Hook reads cachedTargets from metadata, selects first non-excluded, writes ctx.resolved + ctx.provider
steps: Create PipelineContext with cachedTargets=[target1, target2] in metadata
Verify ctx.provider is populated from DB

test_cases.title: builtin:route-resolve aborts when no targets available
test_cases.description: All targets excluded or provider inactive → PipelineAbort(503)

test_cases.title: builtin:format-transform converts openai to anthropic
test_cases.description: When ctx.apiType='openai' and provider.api_type='anthropic', body is transformed
steps: Set ctx.resolved to target with anthropic provider

test_cases.title: builtin:api-key-decrypt caches per provider
test_cases.description: Decrypt API key once, cache in metadata map

test_cases.title: builtin:transport-execute calls orchestrator.handle
test_cases.description: Hook builds transportFn and calls orchestrator, writes result to ctx
steps: Mock orchestrator.handle() to return success result

test_cases.title: builtin:stream-timeout writes SSE error event
test_cases.description: When resilienceResult is stream_abort, write error SSE event to reply
steps: Verify reply.raw.write was called with SSE error data

test_cases.title: builtin:usage-record calls usageWindowTracker
test_cases.description: On successful request, record usage window
steps: Verify recordRequest was called with correct args

test_cases.title: All 6 new hooks registered in proxyPipeline
test_cases.description: After registerBuiltinHooks(), all 15 hooks (9 existing + 6 new) are registered
steps: Verify route-resolve in post_route, format-transform/api-key-decrypt/transport-execute in pre_transport, stream-timeout/usage-record in post_response

test_cases.title: Failover loop is under 150 lines
steps: Assert no forbidden imports (applyProviderPatches, logResilienceResult, etc.)

test_cases.title: Failover with 2 targets: first fails, second succeeds
test_cases.description: Verify failover still works after migration
steps: Insert provider with 2 targets in mapping group
Mock first backend to return 500, second to return 200
Verify response is from second target

test_cases.title: ProviderSwitchNeeded triggers continue
test_cases.description: Orchestrator throws ProviderSwitchNeeded, failover loop continues
steps: Mock orchestrator to throw ProviderSwitchNeeded on first call, succeed on second

test_cases.title: Hook priority ordering: external hook runs after builtins
test_cases.description: Register external hook at priority 200, verify it runs after builtin hooks
steps: Register test hook at pre_transport phase, priority 200
Verify hook execution order: format-transform(0) → api-key-decrypt(1) → transport-execute(50) → provider-patches(100) → test-hook(200)

test_cases.title: PipelineAbort from hook short-circuits pipeline
test_cases.description: If a pre_transport hook throws PipelineAbort, subsequent hooks don't execute
steps: Register hook at pre_transport priority 150 that throws PipelineAbort(403)
Verify transport-execute hook (priority 50) already executed before abort
Verify post_response hooks did NOT execute
